name: agent-harness-codex
description: Explicit-project pseudo-command routing and persistent installation bindings for a standalone Agent Harness

interface.shortDescription: Route project-bound Harness commands without disk search.
interface.longDescription: Recognizes h:<project-alias> <action> <target> [preset], reads exact Harness and project bindings from plugin data, supports h:where and h:report, and resolves lifecycle semantics through registered Extension Packs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use h:<project-alias> <action> <target> [preset], h:where to inspect bindings, or h:report <project-alias> to record the current issue.
